data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Ardelis was believed to be the name of a nymph or goddess associated with the sun. The name Ardelis is derived from the Greek words ardēs, meaning mountain, and helio, meaning sun. The name Ardelis carries the meaning “Mountain of the sun” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ardelis usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
